services.workflowDesc: Queues, records, messages and billing coordinated for the whole care team.

about.headline: Built with doctors, for better care.
about.subheadline: MedAI is a clinical decision support system helping hospitals make faster, safer decisions.

about.valuesDesc: Patient safety first, clinician judgement always, and technology that stays reliable online and offline.
about.teamDesc: Doctors, nurses, administrators and engineers working together on a single shared platform.
about.problemDesc: Busy clinics face long queues, scattered records and delayed decisions that put patients at risk.
about.approachDesc: MedAI combines secure records with AI-assisted triage and diagnosis support that works online and offline.
about.careDesc: Every workflow is designed around safety, dignity and clear communication with patients.
about.supportDesc: AI highlights risks and suggests next steps — the final decision always stays with a qualified doctor.
